en:
[Key Item]
You obtained the ?Fourth Movement.{w}
note: Item name kept with its leading '?', as the source writes the four sheet-music items (?First..?Fourth Movement, slice 037). New name. [acc] Added "the" to match ?First..?Third Movement rows in slice 037.

en: "Oh, hello.{w}Stay as long as you like."{w}

When you reached the summit,
there was a gigantic owl.{w}
note: [acc] Dropped added "waiting" (not in source: ita = was there).

en: "Oh ho, now there's a rare thing.{w}A tiny one has come calling from the world below."{w}{p}"You've come to ask me about the disturbance at the Holy Foundation, Contrachio..."{w}
note: Seikiso Contrachio per glossary note. The yes/no prompt follows as its own row.

en: "That's about the size of it, eh?"

"But as it happens, there's a great deal I don't understand myself.
To think there are things even I, Omshokopo, cannot see through."{w}
Omshokopo let out a weary sigh.{w}
note: yareyare + sigh -> 'weary sigh'. No pronoun for Omshokopo (gender unknown).

en:
"Do you know of the Four Sages of the Land?{w}The Wind Sage is me, Omshokopo.{w}The Fire Sage is Radrecht, in the Scorching Castle."{w}{p}"The Water Sage is Shirinmorin, in the Narmant Trench.{w}And the Earth Sage is Raizam, of the Blanc Desert.{w}The four of us together are called the Four Sages."{w}{p}"...Mind you, there's nothing very sage-like about any of us.{w}Fwah ha ha!!"{w}{p}"When the disturbance struck Contrachio,
I... how shall I put it... came over a little strange...{w}Hmm... I fell into a very odd state of mind."{w}{p}"The Kin of Darkness that appeared at Contrachio...{w}I had to lend them a hand -- I was gripped by that strange notion."{w}{p}"It's a good thing the spirits brought me back to my senses. If I'd stayed like that, who knows what would have happened."{w}{p}"What worries me is the other Sages.{w}I'm afraid they may all have gone strange too..."{w}{p}"The trouble is, beings with as great a presence as ours can't just go tramping about the land."{w}{p}"Sorry to ask, but would you go and see how the other Sages are doing?{w}I'll think of some reward for you."{w}{p}"Just do it along the way on your travels.{w}I'm counting on you."{w}
note: Glossary: Four Sages, Wind/Fire/Water/Earth Sage, Scorching Castle, Narmant Trench, Blanc Desert, Kin of Darkness. 'washira' (we beings of great presence) = the Sages.

en:
"What, that's not it?{w}Is there something else you need to worry about, setting that disturbance aside?"{w}{p}"Well, well...
Tiny ones have tiny horizons, too..."{w}
note: 'chikkoi mono wa shiya mo chikkoi' -- kept the small/small wordplay.

en: "Radrecht... Shirinmorin...{w}Raizam...{w}I do hope they're all right..."{w}
"How were the other Sages doing?"{w}
You told Omshokopo how the three of them were doing.{w}

"I see. In the Scorching Castle the spirits are running wild,
and Shirinmorin has been affected...{w}And Raizam is... moving house? Well, well..."{w}{p}"Well, I've got the gist of it.{w}Shirinmorin got off with no more than a fit of madness,
so there's no need to act right away."{w}{p}"Why Raizam would be thinking of moving house, though...
that does bother me a little..."{w}{p}"Now then, I owe you something for going to look into it for me.{w}Take this with you."{w}
note: 'aterareta' = struck/overcome (as by a poison or an evil influence); read as overcome by the spirits' frenzy. [acc] aterareta has no stated agent; "by it" pointed at the castle spirits, but Shirinmorin is in the Narmant Trench. Kept the cause open.

en: "Perhaps...{w}things are about to get hectic.{w}You take good care of your lives, now."{w}

"Hmmm...{w}I have a feeling I've forgotten
something important..."{w}
Omshokopo is lost in deep thought.{w}

In one corner of the temple, you found a spot
where the ground had been unnaturally dug up.{w}
Search it?
Something might be buried here.{w}You tried digging it up.{w}And then...{w}
{0E}               *  Strange Potato  *{0F}{w}
note: Centred banner; padding approximate, check in game.

en: Rubezahl

"How many tiiimes do I have to teeell youuu!!{w}Stop messing up people's turnip fields...{w}Hm? What's that potato?"{w}{p}"Impossible...{w}I sowed turnip seeds, and got potatoes...!!"{w}{p}"...A... a curse!!{w}It's the curse of the great Dekor!!{w}Wait, who the heck IS Dekor?!"{w}{p}"Somebody heeelp meee!!"{w}
note: dakara stretched -> exasperated 'how many times'. Dekor-sama: no Lord/Lady (gender/nature unknown); 'the great Dekor' keeps the reverence so the 'who IS Dekor' joke works.

en: Rubezahl ran away.{w}

[Key Item]
You obtained a Toryoron Potato.{w}
note: Toryoron Potato as in slice 022.

en: {0E}                *  Giant Turnip  *{0F}{w}
note: Okina kabu: nod to the folk tale 'The Gigantic Turnip'. Centred banner; check in game.

en: "HEY, YOOOU!"{w}
"What kind of mischief are you up to in someone's field?!!{w}You damn braaats!!{w}Thieves! Somebody get over heeere!!"{w}
note: kusogaki = 'damn brats'. nusutto read as plural (the party).

en: You sent Rubezahl packing.{w}
"Dammit aaall!{w}I won't forget this, you damn braaats!!"{w}
You left the spot.{w}
This spot has already been dug up.{w}Nothing will grow back here for a while.{w}

note: Sign drawn as a box of asterisks; three lines padded to the source width (46 half-width columns). Proportional font: check alignment in game.

en:
A mysterious thought spoke into your mind.{w}{p}'Beyond here lies the place where the heart of us, the Dekor, dwells.{w}Those who know not the letters granted by our mother,
the Earth Mother, shall not pass.'{w}
note: Telepathic speech in the source's double hook brackets -> single quotes per brief. 'haha naru chiboshin' -> 'our mother, the Earth Mother' (glossary Earth Mother).
Pyroglyph sign, kept verbatim (box-drawing glyphs are drawn by the font; see slice 017 row 4214). The cipher is a letter substitution of ENGLISH: this reads BEDROOM. Do not translate.

en:
A row of long, narrow rooms.{w}Each is just big enough for one person to lie down,
with a little room to spare.{w}

note: Pyroglyph, verbatim; reads TOILET WOMAN. Full-width space -> one ASCII space (slice 017 precedent).
Pyroglyph, verbatim; reads TOILET MAN.

en: There is a spring and a switch.{w}{p}The switch is weathered and doesn't seem to move.{w}
Drink from the spring?

note: Pyroglyph, verbatim; reads BATHROOM.
Pyroglyph, verbatim; reads MAN.
Pyroglyph, verbatim; reads WOMAN.
Pyroglyph, verbatim; reads DINING HALL.
Pyroglyph, verbatim; reads KITCHEN.

en: This seems to be a washing area.{w}
note: mizuba (place for water); 14014 sits with the BATHROOM sign rooms, so 'washing area'.

en: There are traces of a fire that once burned here.{w}
There are traces of a fire that once burned here.{w}Looking closely, the walls are heavily scorched.{w}

note: Pyroglyph, verbatim; reads GARBAGE.

en: It stinks terribly.{w}

Judging by the arrangement,
these look like chapel pews.{w}
It looks like a chapel lectern.{w}
note: kyoudan = lectern/pulpit platform.

en: All sorts of stains are caked onto it.{w}

note: Pyroglyph, verbatim; reads UNDRESS (changing room).
Pyroglyph, verbatim; reads UNDER CONSTRUCTION.
Pyroglyph, verbatim; reads CHAPEL.

en:
Written in Pyroglyph are the words
'Hold both a good heart and an evil heart.'{w}
note: zenshin/akushin = good/evil heart (alignment), echoed by the next slice's 15008/15010 doors.

en:
Written in Pyroglyph are the words
'Let the Five Primal Races offer their prayers.'{w}
note: Glossary: Five Primal Races.

en: Before you stood a sacred beast, full of majesty.{w}With an overwhelming presence, it spoke to you.{w}
note: shinjuu = sacred/divine beast; 'it' for the Sphinx (a beast, gender not given).

en:
When the Sphinx stirred,
a fierce gust of wind tore through.{w}You were easily blown away.{w}
Sphinx
"Seeker of truth, it has been a long time."{w}
"Very well. You may pass."{w}

"I see.
So you wish to search still deeper for the truth."{w}
The Sphinx swished its tail happily.{w}
"Mm. Just what I expect of one I have acknowledged. I am pleased."{w}

note: Page 2 re-shows page 1 inside {0E}..{0F} (as the source does) and adds 'Why???'.

en: "I cannot hold back. Is that all right?"

"It cannot be helped.
If that is your wish, I accept your challenge.{w}But I am... strong, you know."{w}
"...It has been a while since I last fought.{w}Well, such things will happen."{w}
note: Likely the Sphinx's line on losing the bout (inferred from 'such things will happen').

en: "Indeed. I have no reason to fight you.{w}There is no need to do a thing that has no reason."{w}

"Very well.
Seeker of truth, we shall meet again."{w}
"You are leaving?{w}One with true eyes deserves my goodwill.{w}Should the chance arise, let us meet again."{w}

"I am the guardian of this land.{w}This place, Dekor, is a stairway of truth,
guarded many times over under an ancient pact."{w}{p}"In this land, only those who pursue the truth are worthy."{w}{p}"I ask you this."{w}
"Do you desire the truth?"
"Oh? You say you do not.{w}Then there is nothing more to discuss. Begone."{w}

"Then you will show me proof of it.{w}If you can answer my questions,
I will permit you to enter the heart of Dekor."{w}
note: chuusuu = core/heart (central sanctum).

en: "Good. Then let us begin."{w}

"Well done.
Dekor gladly welcomes you.{w}Now, go forth."{w}

"Fool.
Return to the place that befits you."{w}
